evidence_quotes: Eleda Norge AS, part of the Eleda Group (“Eleda”), has signed an agreement to acquire Nettpartner Bane AS
Nettpartner Bane will be part of Eleda Rail, which consolidates Eleda’s railway maintenance activities.
data.reason: The article reports on an acquisition made by the parent company, Eleda Group, rather than an action taken by the target entity, Eleda Rail Norge AS itself.
